verdict.rationale: OpenHands supports a CLI headless mode with auto-approve for unattended runs, an Agent Server with HTTP/WebSocket API and OpenAPI spec, GitHub Actions-style automations (webhooks, schedules, PR triage, CI failure fixes), and Docker/VM/Apptainer sandbox backends — all clearly enabling CI/automation use. Missing for 10: a dedicated first-party CI example workflow file (e.g. GitHub Actions YAML) and independent third-party confirmation of headless CI runs.
